info.name: Transaction Inquiry API
info.description:
**Retrieve A Transaction allows you to obtain the details and status of a transaction, whether it is successful or failed, using one of the following methods:**

1. **Retrieve Transaction with Order ID or Merchant Order ID(Special Reference Number):** Use the Order ID or the Merchant Order IDto access transaction details.
    
2. **Retrieve Transaction details Transaction ID.** Access transaction details using the Transaction ID
    

**BASE URLs**

| **Country** | **base_url** |
| --- | --- |
| Egypt | [https://accept.paymob.com](https://accept.paymob.com) |
| Saudi Arabia | [https://ksa.paymob.com](https://ksa.paymob.com) |
| United Arab Emirates | [https://uae.paymob.com](https://uae.paymob.com) |
| Oman | [https://oman.paymob.com](https://oman.paymob.com) |

> **Base URL:** `base_url` defaults to Egypt. For another region, either set it to the host above or import the matching environment (`EGY`, `KSA`, `UAE`, `OMN`) from the [collections repository](https://github.com/PaymobAccept/API-Postman-Collections).

request.description: ## 🔐 Generate Authentication Token Generates a bearer token for API authentication. #### 📦 Request Body #### ✅ Required Parameter #### **`API Key`** • String ``` json {"api_key": "YOUR_API_KEY"} ``` ** Usage:** `Authorization: Bearer {token}` **Important Notes:** - Token expires after 60 minutes - Save the token and use it as Bearer token in Authorization header for all subsequent requests - Format: `Authorization: Bearer {your_token}` ### 🔑 Getting Your API Key 1. Log in to your [Paymob Dashboard](https://accept.paymob.com)**.** 2. Navigate to **Settings → Account Info** 3. The API key is the same for **Test Mode** and **Live Mode.** 4. Click Copy next to API Key

## 🔍 Inquire About Transaction using Order ID Retrieve transaction details by querying with the Order ID or Merchant Order ID. The response will include only the most recent transaction associated with the order. ## 🔐 Authorization You need to enter the authentication token value in the token box, as shown in the image below. --- #### ✅ Required Parameter #### **`order_id`** • String or **`merchant_order_id`** • **String** The Order ID or Merchant Order ID associated with the transaction you want to inquire about. Example: ``` json { "order_id": "690898" //"merchant_order_id" : "Stu_1234" } ``` ### **How to get the Order ID?** Answer: You can obtain the Order ID from your dashboard or from the transaction response in a webhook. Please see the screenshots below for both methods. Order ID From Dashboard: Order ID From Transaction Response in Webhook: ### **How to get the Merchant Order ID (**Special Reference)**?** Answer: You can obtain the Special Reference Number or Merchant Order ID from your dashboard or from the transaction response in a webhook. Please see the screenshots below for both methods. You will pass a unique special reference number in this request parameter of intention. Refer to a unique or special identifier or reference associated with a transaction or order. It can be used to track or categorize specific types of transactions, and it is returned in the transaction callback as **merchant_order_id**. # 🔍Fetch Card Token by Order ID

###### Retrieve the card token with the order ID.

#### ✅ Required Parameter

#### **`auth_token`** • String

#### **`order_id`** • String

The Order ID associated with the transaction for which you want to retrieve the card token.

Example:

``` json
{
    "auth_token": "ZXlKaGJHY2lPaUpJVXpVxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx",
    "order_id": 84187
}

 ```

## 📤 Response

### Success • 200 Create

``` json
[
    {
        "type": "TOKEN",
        "obj": {
            "id": 15371731,
            "token": "3a1f71d17618b6a330xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx",
            "masked_pan": "xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-2346",
            "merchant_id": 9930,
            "card_subtype": "MasterCard",
            "created_at": "2026-07-15T23:02:08.043273",
            "email": "dumy@dumy.com",
            "order_id": "566759451",
            "user_added": false,
            "next_payment_intention": "pi_test_b96c5f2e777f4415"
        }
    }
]

 ```### Success • 200 — multiple tokens

When the order has more than one saved card token, the array contains one entry per token.

Returned when the order exists but has no saved card tokens.
